test_title: PYST 49: SSC CPO - General Knowledge and General Awareness (Held on 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: gk
question:
Identify whether the given statements about p-block elements are correct or incorrect.

**Statement A: **In p-block elements, the last electron enters the outermost p orbital.

**Statement B:** The non-metals and metalloids exist only in the p-block of the periodic table.

options.text: Both Statements A and B are correct
Both Statements A and B are incorrect

solution:
The correct answer is __**Both Statements A and B are correct**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **p-block:-**__

 
 
• **In p-block elements, the last electron enters the outermost p orbital.**
 
• The p-block elements have their outermost electrons in the p orbital, and the filling of these orbitals determines their position in the periodic table.
 
• The p-block of the periodic table is a region that includes elements from groups 13 to 18.
 
• This block consists of nonmetals, metalloids, and some metals.
 
• **The majority of elements in the p-block are nonmetals and metalloids, with metals being more prevalent in the earlier groups.**
